result:
Summary: The base model in "Attention Is All You Need" has 65M parameters, 6 layers, 8 heads, and a model dimension of 512. The big model has 213M parameters, 6 layers, 16 heads, and a model dimension of 1024. The big model achieved 28.4 BLEU on the EN-DE translation task and 41.8 BLEU on the EN-FR translation task, trained on 8 P100 GPUs for 3.5 days. The base model was trained on the WMT 2014 English-German dataset and took 12 hours on 8 P100 GPUs.
